name: Attendance Summary
query:
SELECT
  a.employee AS `Employee`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Present`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Absent`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Half Day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Half Day`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'On Leave' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `On Leave`,
  COUNT(a.name) AS `Total Days`,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'Present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.name) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Attendance %`
FROM `tabAttendance` a
WHERE a.docstatus = 1
  AND YEAR(a.attendance_date) = %(year)s
  AND MONTH(a.attendance_date) = %(month)s
  AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR a.employee = %(employee)s)
GROUP BY a.employee
ORDER BY a.employee
